+// ConsistentHashHeader defines consistent hash policy based on HTTP request header.
+type ConsistentHashHeader struct {
+	// HeaderName is the name of the request header.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	HeaderName string `json:"headerName"`
+
+	// RegexRewrite optionally rewrites the header value using regular expression before hashing.
+	// +optional
+	RegexRewrite *HeaderRegexRewrite `json:"regexRewrite,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal short-circuits hash policy calculation if this policy succeeds.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// HeaderRegexRewrite defines regex pattern and substitution for header value rewriting.
+type HeaderRegexRewrite struct {
+	// Pattern is the regex pattern to match.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Pattern string `json:"pattern"`
+
+	// Substitution is the replacement string.
+	// +required
+	Substitution string `json:"substitution"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookie defines consistent hash policy based on HTTP cookie.
+type ConsistentHashCookie struct {
+	// Name is the name of the cookie.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// TTL specifies the cookie time-to-live in Go duration format (e.g. "1h30m") or plain integer seconds (e.g. "3600").
+	// +optional
+	TTL string `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+
+	// Path specifies the path for the generated cookie.
+	// +optional
+	Path string `json:"path,omitempty"`
+
+	// Attributes specifies additional name/value attributes for the generated cookie.
+	// +optional
+	Attributes []CookieAttribute `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal short-circuits hash policy calculation if this policy succeeds.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// CookieAttribute defines a name/value attribute for a cookie.
+type CookieAttribute struct {
+	// Name is the name of the attribute.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Value is the value of the attribute.
+	// +optional
+	Value string `json:"value,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashQueryParameter defines consistent hash policy based on URL query parameter.
+type ConsistentHashQueryParameter struct {
+	// Name is the name of the query parameter.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Terminal short-circuits hash policy calculation if this policy succeeds.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashFilterState defines consistent hash policy based on Envoy filter state.
+type ConsistentHashFilterState struct {
+	// Key is the key in the per-request filterState.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Key string `json:"key"`
+
+	// Terminal short-circuits hash policy calculation if this policy succeeds.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashSourceIP defines consistent hash policy based on client source IP address.
+type ConsistentHashSourceIP struct {
+	// Terminal short-circuits hash policy calculation if this policy succeeds.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
